messages:
Sam (customer-success): Heads up — Lumos postmortem follow-up doc is ready. I listed remediation items and owners. Can folks confirm timelines? TL;DR: VPC peering flaps + on-prem isolation bug caused degraded Dedicated capacity for Lumos last week. Action list below.

Alyssa (eng-runtime): thanks. can you paste the items? i skimmed the doc but want owners assigned.

Sam (customer-success): Sure, copied from doc:
- ACTION-1: Fix peering MTU mismatch in Lumos on-prem edge (owner: Matt) — temp workaround: bump keepalive to 15s. Target: 2026-04-10.
- ACTION-2: Add deterministic reconnect backoff to peering controller (owner: Jordan) — target: 2026-04-17.
- ACTION-3: Patch isolation bug in dedicated agent v1.3.2 (owner: Alyssa) — root cause: race when interface resets. Target: 2026-04-05.
- ACTION-4: Add synthetic canary for VPC peering jitter/packet loss (owner: Priya) — target: 2026-04-20.
- ACTION-5: Customer comms & runbook for on-call (owner: Sam) — target: 2026-04-03.

Matt (eng-sre): I can own ACTION-1. I'll run test spin with Lumos config this week. Putting dev ticket here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-2345

Alyssa (eng-runtime): I'll take ACTION-3. Repro steps in doc are helpful. Plan: backport fix to 1.3.x and ship 1.3.3-canary. estimate 3 days.

Jordan (eng-platform): ACTION-2 accepted. Suggest we gate by perf test. I'll open PR and add rollout plan.

Priya (eng-ml): Synthetic canary — I'll prototype script and wire it into console alerts. Need access to lumos test VPC creds.

Oncall Bot: Incident summary saved: 1977777777. Postmortem link: https://redwood.local/postmortems/lumos-2026-03-29

Matt (eng-sre): one more: recurring pattern — we've seen peering flaps affecting other onprem customers. propose weekly peering trends report and a follow-up epic.

Alyssa (eng-runtime): agree. propose "peering-resilience" epic and triage meeting weekly. also automation to auto-failover to alternate region when jitter > 5%.

Sam (customer-success): I'll coordinate customer comms. schedule: lock in dates by EOD tomorrow. Also need SRE on-call to review runbook.

Jordan (eng-platform): I'll create the epic and link action tickets. ETA for epic kickoff: 2026-04-12.

Priya (eng-ml): can someone add me to lumos-test-vpc IAM? cc @Sam

Sam (customer-success): done — invited Priya. check email.

Alyssa (eng-runtime): Quick note: workaround to enable for Lumos now: set ENV PEER_KEEPALIVE=15 on conductor nodes. do we want to push as hotfix? :thinking_face:

Matt (eng-sre): yes, hotfix for production — i'll coordinate with eng-oncall and schedule maintenance window.

Alyssa (eng-runtime): cool. i'll prep the patch and can do canary during the window.

Sam (customer-success): thanks team. Let's capture owners/timestamps in the postmortem doc. I'll update and ping tomorrow for status.

Jordan (eng-platform): linking tasks: INFR-2345 (Matt), PLAT-6789 (Jordan), RUNTIME-3456 (Alyssa), MON-1122 (Priya), CS-991 (Sam).

Oncall Bot: Reminder: runbook review requested from eng-sre @Matt — due 2026-04-03.

Alyssa (eng-runtime): ack. I'll also add a note about isolation bug telemetry so we can detect earlier.

Matt (eng-sre): ack. tagging this as 'customer-critical' and 'recurring-pattern'.

Sam (customer-success): closing loop for now. thanks everyone :pray:
